newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank says crown not hampering repo cut.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank says crown not hampering repo cut.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Thursday there was nothing stopping it from cutting the repo rate at the current crown level on the condition the other indicators the bank follows were strong.
"The Riksbank could lower the repo rate at the current crown level as long as other indicators look strong," deputy governor Lars Heikensten told a news conference.
He said the crown was merely one of the indicators the Riksbank follows, mentioning inflation expectations and other economic conditions as important indicators.
For the past five months falls in the monthly CPI have given an negative annualised inflation rate.
The repo rate, currently at 4.10 percent, has not been lowered since December 17.
The crown is currently trading at year low against the mark, trading at 4.5490 to the mark in early afternoon trade on Thursday.
